description: Named as the likely writer of the scrap. He was not in the room.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Asked if the insult was a wage, and was told it was not.
name: Richard Cowley

description: Demanded a scene, called the result a crust, and took it.
name: Will Kemp

description: Wrote the turn, kept the names unspelled, and did not start the vault.
name: William Shakespeare
